card_en: Ordinal numbers say which one: prvi, first; drugi, second; tretji, third; četrti, fourth; peti, fifth. They change like adjectives: prvi vlak, prva ulica. Naslednji, next, works the same way.

example.en: When does the first train leave?

first.en: The first street on the right.

second.en: The second street on the right.

third.en: The third street on the right.

quick_check.explain_en: Vlak is masculine, so the ordinal is prvi: prvi vlak.

helper_de: As with erste, zweite, dritte in German, the ending follows the noun: prvi vlak, prva ulica.
helper_en: English first never changes; Slovenian prvi becomes prva with a feminine noun: prva ulica.
